title: Instructor in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery
bio: Dr. Sama Abdul-Aziz received her undergraduate degree from Tufts University and dental degree from Tufts University School of Dental Medicine. She completed her General Practice Residency (GPR) in dentistry at MGH and currently serves as its program director. Additionally, she is an Instructor of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine. Dr. Abdul-Aziz’s clinical interests include all aspects of general dentistry, hospital dentistry, oral medicine, and long-term management of patients following head and neck cancer treatment. She is a member of the American Dental Association and Massachusetts Dental Society.
